topic: Myth: 'A Facebook page is the same as a website'
caption:
Facebook can delete your page tomorrow and there is nothing you can do about it.

A real website is yours. Nobody can take it down, change the rules, or bury it in an algorithm update.

Facebook does not show up when someone Googles your business name. A website does.

We build them for High Desert small businesses. DM us 'SITE' to get started.
